in_sanskrit.name: Sharveer
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है King of Gods
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sharveer एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Sharveer is a combination of two Sanskrit words - Shar and Veer. Shar means the king of the gods and Veer means the brave one. It is a powerful name that represents the supreme power of the gods and the bravery of an individual.
